# Introduction

The aim of this package is to represent phylogenetic trees in real continuous space.

## Installation

You can install ContPhylo from github with:

```{r gh-installation, eval = FALSE}
devtools::install_github("xavierdidelot/ContPhylo")
```

The package can then be loaded using:
```{r}
library(ContPhylo,quietly=T)
```

## More information and getting help

For more detailed examples of how to use ContPhylo, see the vignettes [here](https://github.com/xavierdidelot/ContPhylo/tree/master/vignettes).
See also the help included in the package using the R command
`help(package='ContPhylo')`. 

If you have any problem or question please create an issue [here](https://github.com/xavierdidelot/ContPhylo/issues) 
or get in touch by emailing `xavier.didelot@gmail.com`
